items.title: OpenGL: Mesh shaders in the current year
items.raw_content: Just a quick post to confirm that the OpenGL/ES Working Group has signed off on the release of GL_EXT_mesh_shader . This is a monumental release, the largest extension shipped for GL this decade, and the culmination of many, many months of work by AMD. In particular we all need to thank Qiang Yu (AMD), who spearheaded this initiative and did the vast majority of the work both in writing the specification and doing the core mesa implementation. Shihao Wang (AMD) took on the difficult task of writing actual CTS cases (not mandatory for EXT extensions in GL, so this is a huge benefit to the ecosystem).
items.title_zh: OpenGL：Mesh Shader 的当下进展
items.summary: The OpenGL/ES Working Group has signed off on the GL_EXT_mesh_shader extension, described as the largest GL extension in a decade, with AMD's Qiang Yu leading the specification and core Mesa implementation and Shihao Wang writing conformance test cases.

items.title: China's New Rare Earth and Magnet Restrictions Threaten US Defense Supply Chains
items.raw_content: China has imposed its most stringent rare earth and magnet export controls yet, restricting products with even trace Chinese content. This bolsters its leverage ahead of the Trump-Xi meeting and heightens risks to U.S. defense and semiconductor supply chains.
items.title_zh: 中国新的稀土与磁体出口限制威胁美国国防供应链
items.summary: According to a CSIS analysis, China has imposed its strictest rare earth and magnet export controls yet, restricting products with even trace Chinese content. The report says the move strengthens Beijing's leverage ahead of the Trump-Xi meeting and raises risks to U.S. defense and semiconductor supply chains.
